fcc_description:
Given a string representing a frontmatter block, parse it and return an object (JavaScript) or dictionary (Python) with the keys and values.

Frontmatter is wrapped in --- delimiters and contains key: value pairs within them, one per line. For example:

---
title: My Post
draft: false
views: 100
---

Should return:

{
  title: "My Post",
  draft: false,
  views: 100
}
  • Numbers, Booleans, and Strings should all be returned as their respective type.
  • The given string will have new lines separated with the newline character ("\n"). The above example would be given as: "---\ntitle: My Post\ndraft: false\nviews: 100\n---".
fcc_js_tests:
[{"text": "

parseFrontmatter(\"---\\ntitle: My Post\\ndraft: false\\nviews: 100\\n---\") should return { title: \"My Post\", draft: false, views: 100 }.

", "testString": "assert.deepEqual(parseFrontmatter(\"---\\ntitle: My Post\\ndraft: false\\nviews: 100\\n---\"), { title: \"My Post\", draft: false, views: 100 });"}, {"text": "

parseFrontmatter(\"---\\nid: 6a174db57256a112f932195c\\ntitle: My Book\\nlocale: en\\nwordCount: 10000\\npublished: false\\n---\") should return { id: \"6a174db57256a112f932195c\", title: \"My Book\", locale: \"en\", wordCount: 10000, published: false }.

", "testString": "assert.deepEqual(parseFrontmatter(\"---\\nid: 6a174db57256a112f932195c\\ntitle: My Book\\nlocale: en\\nwordCount: 10000\\npublished: false\\n---\"), { id: \"6a174db57256a112f932195c\", title: \"My Book\", locale: \"en\", wordCount: 10000, published: false });"}, {"text": "

parseFrontmatter(\"---\\nversion: 1.0.0\\nurl: https://example.com\\nprivate: true\\n---\") should return { version: \"1.0.0\", url: \"https://example.com\", private: true }.

", "testString": "assert.deepEqual(parseFrontmatter(\"---\\nversion: 1.0.0\\nurl: https://example.com\\nprivate: true\\n---\"), { version: \"1.0.0\", url: \"https://example.com\", private: true });"}, {"text": "

parseFrontmatter(\"---\\nrating: 4.5\\nprice: 9.99\\n---\") should return { rating: 4.5, price: 9.99 }.

", "testString": "assert.deepEqual(parseFrontmatter(\"---\\nrating: 4.5\\nprice: 9.99\\n---\"), { rating: 4.5, price: 9.99 });"}]
title: Frontmatter Parser
